said.q: When this print was offered at auction in 2002, it was noted that the Museum had the original printer's notations on file, which were quite specific and likely provided by Stieglitz himself. In Sarah Greenough's essay for The Key Set, she notes that this image was included in Stieglitz's last one-person exhibition at An American Place in late 1934, early 1935.
